data.name: ARC
data.description: ARC (Amager Resource Center) is a Danish inter-municipal waste management company that owns and operates the Amager Bakke (CopenHill) waste-to-energy plant in Copenhagen. Together with E.ON under the CopenCapture partnership, ARC is developing a full-scale CCS facility on the plant's flue stack targeting ~400,000–500,000 tonnes CO2/year, with the biogenic portion qualifying as BECCS carbon removal. Waste management and district heating remain ARC's core business.
